title: Settings Profile contents and Game-mode exclusion not documented
reality: docs/chats/settings-profiles.md specifies what a profile actually is: a named bundle holding connection, prompt preset (the 'prompt source' in Conversation), agents and tools, translation, Memory Recall, Advanced Parameters, and other reusable chat options. It explicitly does NOT carry chat-owned content — characters, persona, lorebooks, sprites, summary, tags, scene prompt — nor conversation history. Profiles work in Conversation and Roleplay only; GAME MODE DOES NOT SHOW THE PROFILE CONTROLS. references/architecture.md records the rename but none of this substance.
fix: Expand the Settings Profiles note in references/architecture.md with the includes/excludes list and the Game-mode exclusion. The exclusion is the highest-value item: recommending a settings profile to a Game-mode user is advice that cannot be followed.

title: A prompt preset nests inside a settings profile — relationship not stated
reality: docs/chats/settings-profiles.md states the two concepts are not siblings: 'A prompt preset can therefore be one item inside a settings profile.' The skill's v2.4.0 rename note treats them as parallel-but-distinct without capturing the containment relationship.
fix: Add one sentence to the vocabulary block in references/architecture.md: a prompt preset is one field a settings profile can carry, not an alternative to it. Prevents the wrong mental model of two competing preset systems.

title: Backup & Restore guide not cited alongside the new automatic backups
reality: docs/data/backup-and-restore.md is the authoritative user guide for the backup surface that v2.4.0 extended with rotating daily/weekly/monthly automatic full backups. The skill documents the new automatic backups but points at no guide, and its Data Storage section still frames backup as 'copy DATA_DIR/storage'.
fix: Cite docs/data/backup-and-restore.md from the Data Storage section of references/architecture.md and soften the copy-the-directory framing now that a first-class scheduled backup exists with UI-visible run/failure state.

title: Docs tree paths not enumerated for lookup
reality: The engine docs are a structured tree: docs/chats/ (branches, chat-settings, connected-chats, export-import, group-chats, guided-and-impersonate, managing-chats, messages, peek-prompt, sending-and-streaming, settings-profiles, slash-commands), docs/data/ (backup-and-restore, clearing-data, importing-from-sillytavern, where-data-is-stored), docs/settings/, docs/agents/, docs/extending/, docs/prompts/, docs/development/. SKILL.md notes the tree exists but names no files, so the fastest authoritative lookup is left implicit.
fix: Add a compact path map to SKILL.md's 'Core operating principle' section, or to references/architecture.md, listing the notable guide filenames per directory. Turns 'check the docs' into a directly actionable fetch.

title: guided-and-impersonate guide corroborates the missing Impersonate coverage
reality: docs/chats/guided-and-impersonate.md is a dedicated user guide pairing guided generation with Impersonate. The references cover 'guided' only incidentally and have no Impersonate section — independent doc-side confirmation of the pass-B finding.
fix: Same fix as pass B: add an Impersonate subsection to references/architecture.md, and cite docs/chats/guided-and-impersonate.md as the upstream guide.
